subject.title: feat(system-agent): auto-hatch into the agent after fresh setup

question: Should a successful first-time setup automatically leave the custodian and preload the agent’s bootstrap message across terminal, web, and macOS clients?
rationale: This changes the first-run onboarding transition rather than repairing an established failure-only contract; the PR body cites a redesign plan, but the supplied review context contains no independent maintainer decision confirming that this exact automatic handoff remains the desired product behavior.

options.title: Confirm and land after proof
options.body: Keep the typed hatch intent and land once fresh web and macOS after-fix evidence is attached and the branch is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Keep setup in the custodian
options.body: Retain the existing explicit handoff flow if maintainers prefer users to choose when to enter agent chat after configuration.

options.title: Narrow to one approved client flow
options.body: Ship the hatch only on the client surface explicitly covered by the onboarding decision and defer the remaining client integrations.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the typed hatch intent and land once fresh web and macOS after-fix evidence is attached and the branch is refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged and proposed onboarding history connects this contributor most directly to the surrounding custodian and hatch design.
